in_marathi.name: Dharmakant
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dharmakant हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name that signifies one who carries out his dharma or duty towards the society, his family, and the divine. It is a powerful name that is often found in Hindu mythology and scriptures.
